description: ISSUE-201, ADR-013 items 2-3, 15 §4.2: a launch with both delegation gates on (the request carries a ticket-file DelegationInjection). The Host writes the --mcp-config file before the spawn; it holds only the relay entry (command, args, and the relay's own env with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE and the credential file PATH), registered as dwarfai. The argv pins the permission mode (AMENDMENT-19), passes the file's path, and pre-approves exactly DwarfAI's two delegation tools (ADR-008 item 3's named exception, C-24). No credential value and no DWARFAI_DELEGATION_TOKEN string is in the argv, the env or the file (C-23, INV-59, INV-83). launchArgv and mcpConfigFile are read by the driver's own test.
